input.body:
label: bug
file: src/ingest/dedupe.ts

The CSV exporter isn't at fault here. The dedupe key built in `dedupeKey` (src/ingest/dedupe.ts) only uses `date`, `amount`, and `description`, so two transactions that differ only by currency hash to the same key and one gets dropped as a duplicate during ingest, before it ever reaches the CSV export. The key needs to include `currency` as well.

text: The dedupe key doesn't include currency, so transactions differing only by currency are treated as duplicates and dropped during ingest—not in csv.ts as the reporter guessed.
